fields.description:
# RF-13b: Pause Button — Confirm Reason Capture

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Pause remains a status on the Referrer record (Account, Referrer record type); it is a review state, not a removed/deprecated status.
* A Pause button on the Referrer record opens a screen flow that captures a Pause Reason.
* Pause Reason is a required single-select field.
* On submission, the flow sets Referrer Status = Paused on the record.

### FIELDS

* Pause Reason — Picklist (single-select), required. Values: Waiting Ops Verification, Proof Quality Under Review, Payout Details Missing or Invalid, Duplicate Under Review / Possible Duplicate Referral Record.

### NOTES

* Provenance: raised in the Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning sync, alongside the Ban button question; confirmed in the Aug 25 Wagertech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync.
* Related: [BUILD-232 — Referrer: Ban Button — Confirm Reason/Notes Capture](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217801011390356/f/) (same question, Ban side).

### SOURCE

* Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning — [transcript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qB7cUeJGFs_SZba9NX5R9MWKzOj8yTetmWTWoqY3gw8/edit), verified.
* Aug 25 Wagertech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync — not recorded or accessible via the connected Fathom account; sourced from a transcript Taryn pasted directly into chat.
* Dependencies: [BUILD-197 — Referrer: Pause Automation](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693050760611/f/), [BUILD-189 — Referrer: Restriction Detail Fields](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693083539212/f/)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-24 from the Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning sync. Updated 2026-08-26 with confirmation from the Aug 25 Weekly Sync; IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS restructured to an absolute spec same day.

comments.body: Confirmed in the Aug 25 Wagertech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync. The Pause button and captured Pause Reason are still wanted. Lina read the mockup's Pause Reason list aloud on the call — Waiting Ops Verification, Proof Quality Under Review, Payout Details Missing or Invalid, Duplicate Under Review / Possible Duplicate Referral Record — and Joyce confirmed all of it as-is, no changes.

Pause button field and flow has been created: [https://nosoftware-nosoftware-7430--partialsb.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/FlowRecord/2aFWJ00000488an2AA/view](https://nosoftware-nosoftware-7430--partialsb.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/FlowRecord/2aFWJ00000488an2AA/view)

Flagging for consideration, not a confirmed decision yet: does Paused actually need a status banner the way Banned does?

Right now this ticket only builds the button and screen flow — it captures a Pause Reason and sets Referrer Status = Paused, nothing else. There's no banner showing this on the record page. Given the Pause feature itself was only confirmed as still-wanted in the Aug 25 Weekly Sync, and the backend beyond the status-field update hasn't been built out, it may be worth holding off on a banner until the button and its automation are further along.
